title: CLI session authorization response
description: When replaying a completed CLI session, the provider MUST require the same verified issuer and subject that originally authorized the session, then return key_id only after row-locking an active, unrevoked, unexpired API key owned by the same authenticated organization whose persisted scopes remain a non-empty unique subset of the current allowlist; missing or mismatched authorizing identity, cross-tenant, malformed, empty, duplicate, retired-scope, revoked, or expired key references MUST fail closed. Completed-session replay MUST compare the persisted authorizing issuer, subject, and organization to the verified active membership immediately after the session row lock and before evaluating session expiry or accessing the referenced API key; a mismatch MUST fail closed without disclosing session expiry or key state. API-key expiry MUST be evaluated after the referenced key row lock is acquired, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same serializable transaction; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden.
